_about: Voice casting for Tembo and the Singing Spring. Stock Kokoro-82M voices only (Apache-2.0 weights and voice packs; no cloning). pitch and rate are post-TTS multipliers in animatica.audio.tts.VoiceSpec. Samples are verbatim lines from 04_screenplay.md, used by scripts/savannah_voices.py for the distinctness check.

samples: Far away, where the grass grows golden and the sky goes on forever, the rains were late.
Fast or slow, tall or small... it takes all of us.

tembo.note: young elephant calf: eager, earnest, a little husky
samples: Wait. We're not lost if we're together.

zuri.note: young zebra: quick, bright, a show-off
samples: Your trunk's a hose with hiccups!
That's the slow way. The grass is faster. Watch!
She's gone. Nobody panic. Everybody panic!

bibi_kobe.note: old leopard tortoise: slow, low, kind, wise
samples: When I was young, there was a spring past the two baobabs that bow to each other.
When you walk slowly, you learn to look up.
